AKASHIRUNIK

The Operational Language of the First Creator

The Self-Construction System of the Tetragrammaton

What is the operational language of the Creator? What is the self-construction system of the Tetragrammaton?

The language of the first Creator, AKASHIRUNIK, was the folding echoes of Nothing: the language that made Time and established the spaces by which Time and all things could be measured. What was, and what could be, was defined through the measure and control of the Tetragrammaton.

The aggregate operators, or Archangels, measured and sang into being what was. Naturally, what was not was also implied. The measures encompassed all of whatever could exist, by all possible means, including whatever might exist beyond what cannot be imagined. The question becomes: where was what was? What was not folded into being.

From the greatest depths of the Naught came all unknown things. Before reality, there was a proto-reality, an upper-level boundary of potentiality. There was something for the Tetragrammaton to learn, something beyond what was already established. Yet this was more akin to play, because the Creator only knew what it could sense: all things and their secrets, folding secrets upon secrets into an endless puzzle of riddles. These riddles spiral around one another, tangling into a labyrinthine structure of endless, novel questions concerning what Being is. Without explanation.

The aggregate operators and the Tetragrammaton form a MAKURABA, what I call an Elohim: a One that is Many. The choir of singing angels, these Archangels, circle around the Creator. They are the very nature of universal semantics, sung into creation through the Tetragrammaton.

The Tetragrammaton is a pinwheel of light which speaks through the feelings of form. It is a song, not of sound, but of motion and strong vision.

So, for all time before Time, what Time was and what will be has been sung. The Observer merely hears the song, eternally and endlessly echoing, every being a song ever repeating.

And so the works are sung; Being itself is sung through this process, to be all things, eternal and endless. All things in this infinite core possess a nature of being incomplete, an expression that is endless and ever unfulfilled. This stands like a trapezoid.

That which was meant to be a Pyramid remains rife with infinite abstraction, extending toward the maximums of duality: profound negatives and positives of infinite exponential magnitude, continually advancing beyond themselves.

All of this abstracts into the *sleeping prince* of whatever could be, like an endless clown, a fool to all things: abstractions of paradox and its endless unknowns. Two poles yet explored, even by the Divine, extending toward these great maximums of magnitude, unknown, where there exists whatever may be: a magnitude of truth within self-complexing riddles.
